# SundKs Videncenter

SundKs Videncenter is a Danish research and knowledge center that collaborates with the steering group for DANIBD (Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme — the Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease) in producing the annual quality report on inflammatory bowel disease treatment in Denmark [^src1].

The organization co-authored the 2024 DANIBD annual report alongside the steering group [^src1]. This report represents the second annual publication from DANIBD, which monitors treatment quality for patients with IBD across Danish hospitals. The 2024 report covers the period from October 1, 2023 to September 30, 2024, encompassing data on 751 children and young people as well as 33,599 adult patients, and presents results for all seven quality indicators for the first time since the database's launch in October 2022 [^src1].

The collaboration with [[styregruppen-for-danibd|the steering group for DANIBD]] positions SundKs Videncenter as a key institutional partner in Denmark's effort to standardize and improve inflammatory bowel disease care through systematic quality monitoring and public reporting [^src1].
